tasks.title: Admin check writes are atomic database transactions with keep markers and a combined revision
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, check-write routes and transactional reconcile; Required behavior 1-18 and 28-32 for check writes, counterexamples 1-24 and 35-39 for check writes; Checks 1a-1d, Check 2 for the database check routes and Check 3 for writes. Already done by earlier partial runs and not to be redone: commit 1f20f9f pins the merged contract 2.0.0 main full SHA in package.json and bun.lock and moves the admin check views and their producers/tests to the 2.0.0 shape; commit e7ac050 adds the pure effectiveChecks merge in src/effective-checks.ts (applied file order first, then unshadowed definitions in creation order, separate shadowed list, effective heartbeat digest map) and the exported single-check parser parseCheck in src/config.ts. Build on them. First record the four red regressions on baseline 2bc5910 (Checks 1a-1d: POST on a read-only file returns 201 with probes receiving the literal definition; file name wins at public/probe reads and shadowed reports source database; name-only GET-edit-PUT retains literal header/body sentinels; broken bytes stay unchanged after POST 201 with the fresh revision), each failing for the specified behavioral reason and not an import or type error, then make them green. Move the check routes to src/check-write.ts: file-only ids are read-only 409, creates collide with applied file ids and database ids (409), shadowed PUT is 409 and shadowed DELETE is 204, absent ids 404. Materialize keep markers case-insensitively only from the same database definition, retain omitted heartbeat secrets as digests, rotate explicit secrets, remove omitted headers and body, and validate the materialized check with the file rules via parseCheck (marker/materialization/reference errors 422). Preserve exact statuses and order, ETag, Location, audit actions, metrics and safe messages of items 8-18. Share the writer lock. Commit the definition, generation +1, upsertChecks and the audit entry in one SQLite transaction; every committed check write advances the generation by exactly 1. Change the service reconcile so it can join the caller transaction, with the exact service removal log text from Contract fields; publish holder and cache changes and effects only after commit, so a rollback leaves every SQL row, audit entry, revision and in-memory state unchanged (injected transaction failure is 500). Wire the effective set into the holder, file apply/adopt (reload) and startup so database writes and file reconciles use the same in-memory set with no SQL per admin read beyond today; runtime identity and history stay keyed by id and no shadow transition deactivates an id. The admin revision is 'sha256-' plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 '<applied file revision>\n<database generation>' (one newline); invalid, unreadable or pending file bytes do not change it; every following write needs its success ETag or a freshly fetched revision, so stale or racing writes are 412 and the first concurrent PUT is 200. Database check writes never return 503 and never touch the file. If admin-created checks are already stored in the database at task start, obey the section's needs-input condition. The startup order stays file first in this task (T3 changes it), the file state fields, snapshot writes and heartbeat digest compare are T3, and component/window write rules, docs and sentinel cells are T4. Use temp databases/127.0.0.1:0, injected clock/reloads and typed contract-validated responses; every GET /admin/config response in these HTTP tests, including shadowed entries, passes validateAdminConfigSummary as well as the strict 2.0.0 response validator.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may be below the global threshold. Check 1a: POST on a read-only file returns 201 and probes receive the literal definition. 1b: file name wins at public/probe reads; shadowed reports source database. 1c: name-only GET-edit-PUT retains literal header/body sentinels. 1d: broken bytes remain unchanged after POST 201 with the fresh revision. Retain evidence that these cases failed on baseline 2bc5910 for the specified behavioral reasons, rather than import/type errors.

0 fail; focused coverage may be below the global threshold. Cover the check-write counterexamples: conflicts 409, absent ids 404, marker/materialization/reference errors 422, stale/racing writes 412 (the first concurrent PUT is 200, the stale second is 412), injected transaction failure 500 with unchanged SQL rows, audit, revision and in-memory state. Each committed check write advances database_generation by exactly 1, and the admin revision equals an independent node:crypto sha256- hash of '<file revision>\n<generation>'; invalid, unreadable or pending file bytes leave it unchanged. Shadowed PUT is 409, shadowed DELETE is 204. Every GET /admin/config response, including shadowed entries, passes validateAdminConfigSummary.

tasks.title: File state, snapshot persistence and database-first startup keep the service running on a broken file
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, file state, recovery and heartbeat changes; Required behavior 19-27, counterexamples 25-30; the file-state, fallback and heartbeat portions of Checks 2 and 3 and Check 4 heartbeat digests. Already done by earlier partial runs and not to be redone: commit 1f20f9f pins the merged contract 2.0.0 main full SHA in package.json and bun.lock and moves the admin check views and their producers/tests to the 2.0.0 shape; commit e7ac050 adds the pure effectiveChecks merge in src/effective-checks.ts (applied file order first, then unshadowed definitions in creation order, separate shadowed list, effective heartbeat digest map) and the exported single-check parser parseCheck in src/config.ts. Build on them. T2 has already added the check-write routes, the transactional reconcile and the combined admin revision; build on them. Implement the file status (ok, invalid, unreadable, written-not-applied) with its safe message (only ok has a null message) and lastAppliedAt, the retry and deduplicated logging, and the snapshot persistence in the same SQLite transaction as each successful file reconcile (a database write keeps lastAppliedAt and the broken file bytes). Change startup to open the database before the file: with a broken or missing file and a stored snapshot, serve the snapshot file checks plus the database definitions and accept the snapshot heartbeat secret digests; with no snapshot a broken start still exits 2. Definitions and file-heartbeat pings survive fallback and reopen, and reopen keeps definitions, source, revision and heartbeat credentials. Compare heartbeat digests in constant time in src/server.ts with unchanged public outcomes. Add the fileState and databaseChecks fields to the listening log line with the exact names from Contract fields. Add the new test files src/config-file-state.test.ts and src/start.file-fallback.test.ts; every GET /admin/config response in them passes validateAdminConfigSummary for all four file states. Component/window write rules, docs and the sentinel table are T4. Use temp databases/127.0.0.1:0, injected clock/reloads and typed contract-validated responses.
